what: Moon Phase Calendar shows the Moon's phase for today or any date: its name, how much of it is lit, its age in days and its distance, drawn the way it looks from your hemisphere.

It lists the exact dates and times of the next new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter in your time zone, gives moonrise, moonset and the time the Moon is highest for your place, and has a month calendar with every day's phase drawn, ready to print.
uses: Pick a full moon for bright landscapes or a new moon for dark skies.
Check new and full moons for festivals and fasting months.
Many people plan by the lunar cycle.
The darkest nights are around the new moon.
Watch the phases change through a month.
See when the Moon rises and how bright it will be.
tutorial: Search for your city or press Use my location. Moonrise and moonset depend on where you are.
The big picture shows the phase, the lit percentage, whether it is growing (waxing) or shrinking (waning), and its age.
The cards show moonrise, moonset and when the Moon is highest, with compass directions.
Next main phases gives the date and time of the next new, first quarter, full and last quarter moons.
Use the arrows to change month. Tap any day to see its details at the top.
Press Print / PDF for a one-page moon calendar with the phase times.
features: Accurate lit shape for every day.
Flipped automatically for the southern hemisphere, or choose yourself.
To about a minute, in your own time zone.
With quarter days highlighted and a print view.

example.title: Example: the eclipse full moon of September 2025
example.text: Choose London and the date 7 September 2025. The tool shows Full Moon, 100% lit, with the exact full moon at 19:09 (BST), matching the published 18:09 UTC. Switch to Sydney and the picture flips, because the Moon looks the other way up from the southern hemisphere.

tips: The Moon rises around sunset when it is full and around sunrise when it is new.
For the darkest skies, plan stargazing within a few days of the new moon.
A first quarter moon is lit on the right in the northern hemisphere and on the left in the southern.
Print the calendar each month and stick it on the fridge.
problems: The time of the full moon is a day off from another site
Full moon is one moment worldwide; in some time zones that moment falls on the next or previous date. Check that the right place is chosen.
That is normal about once a month: the Moon rises after midnight, on the next date.
The Moon looks the wrong way round
Choose your hemisphere in "Show the Moon as seen from". Near the equator the Moon looks tipped on its side.
